# libnds (not included)

DSLeaf is built with **libnds** from devkitPro (https://github.com/devkitPro/libnds). Its source is not in this repository. `LICENSE.txt` is its licence (the zlib licence), copied from `libnds_license.txt` of the devkitPro installation on 2026-11-03. The zlib licence does not ask for a notice in a binary, but the About screen shows it anyway (decision 087).
